run_tfe_benchmarks: run the TFE benchmark training loop on MNIST with a chosen network and number of epochs
create_benchmark_model: create a PyTorch benchmark model (NetworkA, NetworkB, or NetworkC) by name
create_private_benchmark_model: create an encrypted Crypten private model from an existing PyTorch benchmark model
validate: validate a model on the MNIST test set and return top-1 accuracy
train: train a model for one epoch on the MNIST training set with SGD and logging
